01 · Valeting

Platinum Valet

£110About 4–6 hoursAt your home or workplace

The Platinum Valet is the most thorough valet we offer. It includes everything in the Full Valet, then adds the jobs that take real time: leather seats deep cleaned and reconditioned, the roof lining cleaned, the wheel arches cleaned, and temporary protection applied to the paint.

Book a Platinum Valet Not sure? Send photos

Who it's for

  • Cars that need serious time spending on them to bring them back
  • Cars with leather interiors
  • Preparing a car for sale
  • Anyone who wants every part of the car cleaned in one visit

What's included

Exterior

  • Citrus pre-wash to loosen road dirt
  • Snow foam soak
  • Hand contact wash
  • Door shuts cleaned
  • Fuel cap cleaned
  • Hydrophobic rinse coating
  • Temporary paint protection applied [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: type, e.g. spray sealant or wax, and a realistic lifespan in weeks.]

Wheels & tyres

  • Wheels cleaned
  • Wheel arches cleaned
  • Tyres dressed

Interior

  • Vacuumed throughout, including mats and boot
  • Dashboard cleaned, including air vents
  • Steering wheel, indicator stalks and interior plastics cleaned
  • Windscreen and interior windows cleaned
  • Foot pedals cleaned
  • Fabric seats shampooed and extracted
  • Mats shampooed
  • Carpets shampooed
  • Boot deep cleaned
  • Leather seats deep cleaned and reconditioned
  • Roof lining cleaned

What isn't included

  • Removing swirls, haze or scratches from paint. This needs machine polishing.
  • Long-term paint protection. This needs a ceramic coating.
  • Repairs to damaged trim, torn upholstery or worn leather

What to expect

The cleanest your car can be without working on the paint itself. Leather will be clean and conditioned. Roof linings are easily damaged, so they're cleaned with care, and some old marks may only fade. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: how you approach roof linings and what customers should expect.]

The paint will be clean, with a hydrophobic finish and a layer of temporary protection. Any swirls and scratches will still be there, and they often look clearer on clean paint. If that matters to you, ask about machine polishing.

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: which service this job was. Swap the photo if it wasn't a Platinum Valet.]

How the Platinum compares

Compared with the Full Valet (£65): the Platinum adds leather seats deep cleaned and reconditioned, roof lining cleaned, wheel arches cleaned, temporary paint protection applied.

Want the paint improved as well?

Machine polishing reduces swirls and light scratches, and a ceramic coating protects the finish for longer.

Platinum Valet questions

Why does it take 4–6 hours?

The time depends on the size of the car and its condition. Leather, roof linings and wheel arches can't be rushed.

Is the Platinum the same as detailing?

No. The Platinum is a very thorough clean and includes temporary protection, but it doesn't work on the paint itself. Detailing uses machine polishing to reduce defects and coatings to protect the finish.
